content.short: Nium-owned cross-border payments and remittance brand.
content.description: Instarem, launched in 2014 and now the consumer remittance brand of the global payments company Nium, lets individuals and businesses send money across borders quickly and at competitive exchange rates. Operating from Singapore across many markets, it offers international transfers to bank accounts and wallets, a rewards program, and a multi-currency prepaid card for spending abroad, all backed by Nium's licensed global payments infrastructure. Instarem targets migrants, families, freelancers, and SMEs who need reliable, low-cost remittances and FX without the markups of traditional banks. By pairing a consumer-friendly app with enterprise-grade payment rails, it delivers transparent cross-border transfers across a wide network of send and receive corridors.
content.meta: Instarem is Nium's cross-border remittance brand for low-cost global transfers. Discover Instarem and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
